recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR source follow-up is needed for FHIR-27095 unless a future issue changes the example or SearchParameter extension guidance.
issue_request: FHIR-27095 was Published with a Persuasive technical correction for the SearchParameter extension example. The issue said the example was for Patient but used DocumentReference.extension('http://example.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/participation-agreement'); the requested expression was Patient.extension('http://example.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/participation-agreement'). The resolution said to fix the CI build going forward and also fix inappropriate XPath whitespace.
initial_application: The issue was applied on the main FHIR source history by commit 8e83788ee1, which changed source/searchparameter/searchparameter-example-extension.xml to describe the Patient extension referencing DocumentReference and to use the Patient.extension(...) FHIRPath. A same-day SearchParameter.xpath cleanup, commit 60013afa21, removed the XPath element from this example, so the whitespace concern no longer exists in current source.
additional_context: SearchParameter is an active resource in source/fhir.ini, and source/searchparameter/list-SearchParameter-examples.xml includes searchparameter-example-extension, so the example source is in current build scope. Current source/searchparameter/searchparameter-example-extension.xml has base Patient, target DocumentReference, and the corrected Patient.extension(...) expression. Jira neighborhood search found only FHIR-27095 for the participation-agreement/SearchParameter wording, and Zulip/Confluence searches found no conflicting community discussion.
reconciliation: No source edit was made. The incorrect DocumentReference.extension(...) expression is absent from source/searchparameter, and the corrected Patient.extension(...) expression is present in the authoritative example.
